id: title:Gilbert09:retry a transient temporal connect failure in post load triggers

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion recovery from transient Temporal frontend connectivity failures
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 implements a helper function `_is_retryable_temporal_rpc_error` that broadens the definition of retryable errors to include `RuntimeError` exceptions with the message prefix "Failed client connect:". review.uncertainty: The score relies solely on the helper function implementation and its test; the actual retry execution and workflow recovery behavior are not present in this chunk, so the tier is assigned based on the established helper rather than demonstrated recovery. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the retry mechanism or the actual workflow execution, only the helper function and a test. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: The helper function `_is_retryable_temporal_rpc_error` was changed to also treat `RuntimeError` exceptions with the string prefix "Failed client connect:" as retryable, alongside the existing `RPCError` statuses. This addresses transient connection failures before an RPC client is established.
observations.posthog_connection: This allows the warehouse ingestion pipeline to recover from transient connectivity issues (like DNS blips or connection resets) to the Temporal frontend, rather than permanently dropping the import trigger. The implementation checks the exception type and message, not just the RPC status code.
